info.title: LumenBazaar Backend API
info.description: Facilitator, seller catalog, discovery, and conformance APIs for LumenBazaar.

x-rate-limiting.description: The API implements distributed rate limiting across all replicas using Redis. Each endpoint scope has different limits per 60-second window.

scopes.facilitator: Payment verification and settlement endpoints (verify, settle): 60 requests per minute per API key or IP
scopes.seller: Seller management endpoints (create, verify domain): 30 requests per minute per API key or IP
scopes.discovery: Resource discovery and catalog endpoints: 120 requests per minute per API key or IP

headers: x-ratelimit-limit: Maximum requests in current window
x-ratelimit-remaining: Requests remaining in current window
x-ratelimit-reset: ISO 8601 timestamp when window resets
retry-after: Seconds to wait before retrying (429 responses only, RFC 6585)
x-rate-limiting.identification: Authenticated seller API keys are identified by their key ID; other requests use the x-api-key header value if present, otherwise by request IP address (x-forwarded-for not trusted)
x-rate-limiting.behavior: During Redis unavailability, rate limiting degrades to in-memory per-instance limits, prioritizing availability over perfect enforcement
